texts: THE COLDEST ANYTHING CAN EVER BE

scenes.ticker: BREAKING: GLOBAL TEMPERATURE DROPS 3°C IN 3 MONTHS  •  SCIENTISTS BAFFLED  •  SNOW REPORTED IN JULY  •

caps: Month 4. It snows in Canada. In July.
Ships are trapped in the ice.

banners: PLAN A: GIANT MIRRORS IN SPACE
caps: The mirrors can't catch enough sunlight.

banners: PLAN B: BURN THE RAINFORESTS FOR HEAT
caps: The smoke only blocks more sunlight.
Month 12. Riots in every major city.

label: A NORMAL WINTER DAY. IN SUMMER.
#9fdcff

caps: The warm countries close their borders.
There is not enough room for everyone.
The frozen north invades the south.
Millions die for a little warmth.
Year 2.5. The oceans start to freeze.
Heat from below is the only heat left.

bubs: Good luck... to all of us.
scenes.ticker: FINAL BROADCAST  •  -60°C  •  STAY UNDERGROUND  •  CONSERVE HEAT  •

bubs: How long can we last down here?

caps: The air itself starts to freeze.
Year 9. Fuel runs out. Reactors fail.
One by one, the lights go out.
Whole cities freeze in their bunkers.
The sky begins to fall... as rain.
The atmosphere collapses into lakes of liquid air.
Year 22. Only the volcano bunkers remain.
Heat from the Earth's core keeps them alive.

stamps: THE COLDEST ANYTHING CAN EVER BE
